name: Harrison James
intro: I build web products with Python, Django and PostgreSQL: payments, APIs, background jobs and the tests that keep them working. I ship them with Docker to DigitalOcean and AWS, and build the front end in React or Next.js when a project needs one. 3 years of turning ideas into products people use.

anime.line: Not giving up is my magic.

seo.title: Harrison James · Backend Engineer (Python, Django) in Lagos, Nigeria
seo.description: Harrison James, backend engineer in Lagos, Nigeria: Python, Django, PostgreSQL. Co-founder and lead developer of Kinomos, lead developer of SeeBlu. Open to remote roles.
